title: Welcome to InfiniBot
description: Five minutes to understand what InfiniBot is, how to navigate it, and where to go next. Auto-assigned to every new user.

steps.title: What InfiniBot does for you
steps.body:
InfiniBot is a personal AI control room. Think of it as one place where every tool you use — chat, projects, your calendar, your business pipeline, your video editor — talks to the same AI agent that knows your context.

**You'll come away from this walkthrough knowing:**
- How the navigation works
- How to open a chat and ask the agent to do something
- Where to find your user profile and language preferences
- What other walkthroughs exist for the deeper features

Everything is reversible. You can't break anything by clicking around.

steps.title: The navigation sidebar
steps.body:
On the left edge of the screen is your navigation sidebar. Tabs are grouped by purpose:

- **Chat** — single chat, multi-session grid, voice mode
- **Media** — video studio, storyboard
- **Business** — projects, business center, clients, leads
- **Agent** — the agent's tools, schedule, autonomy, skills
- **Settings** — your profile, appearance, integrations, this Learn page

Click around. The active tab highlights in your accent color. Press the tab again to refresh.

steps.title: Send your first message
steps.body:
Open the Chat tab and type something — anything. The agent has access to:

- Your filesystem (under your home directory)
- Web search and web fetch
- Your other tabs' data (it can read your projects, your business, your calendar)
- Tools like running a shell command, reading a file, generating an image

Good first prompts:
- *"What can you see in my projects?"*
- *"Summarize my calendar this week"*
- *"Help me write a one-pager for X"*

The agent will tell you when it's about to do something risky and ask for permission.

steps.title: Your profile + language
steps.body:
Settings → Users → click your row. Here you set:

- **Language** — the agent will respond in this by default. Set it to `Spanish — formal` or `Thai` or whatever you need.
- **Background context** — a short paragraph the agent reads at the start of every session. Put your role, your current focus, your preferences here. The agent will treat this as load-bearing context.
- **Password** — change your login password.

The context field is the highest-leverage setting on this page. Treat it like a system prompt for *yourself*.

steps.title: Where to go next
steps.body:
You've seen the basics. Pick a walkthrough for the area that matters most to you:

- **Chat & Sessions** — multi-session grid, voice mode, sub-agents
- **Projects & Kanban** — kanban-style projects with auto-run tasks
- **Business Center** — revenue tracking, clients CRM, Whop/Stripe sync
- **Video Studio** — composition editor, AI asset analysis, ComfyUI rendering
- **Mobile** — get the iOS/Android companion app via Expo Go or a personal IPA
- **Multi-User Admin** *(admin only)* — adding users, page gating, agent directory locking

Each is 5–15 minutes. Mark this one complete and pick the next one from the Library tab.
